deviations.what: The controller builds the IconTabFilters (and their content Texts) in a loop with addItem( ). abap2UI5 has no client-side control factory, so the port binds the items aggregation to a table holding the same 12 rows (Tab 1..12 / Content 1..12) and declares one IconTabFilter template with its content Text - structural-diff reports both as control extra because the original's view carries only the empty IconTabBar.

onInit gives every tab a RANDOM icon out of three (history, home, employee) with Math.random. A backend cannot repeat a client-side random draw, so the port walks the same three icons in order (index MOD 3) - same three icons over the same twelve tabs, deterministic instead of random.
